context: E-Commerce & Bookkeeping Financial Web App for Small Egg (Telur) Business in Indonesia
theme: Warm Organic & Earthy with 3D Anti-Gravity Elements (Archetype 1 + Luxury Touch)

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle warm noise overlay & golden glowing gradient orbs

layouts.header: Sticky glassmorphism navigation with brand logo, smooth scroll navigation links, currency badge, and Quick Action CTA
layouts.hero_section: Landing page with 3D Anti-Gravity Floating Egg interactive Canvas (React Three Fiber + Drei Float + Framer Motion), headline in Indonesian, and stats counter
layouts.dashboard_section: Comprehensive bookkeeping dashboard with financial stats (Pemasukan, Pengeluaran, Laba Bersih, Stok Telur Peti), interactive Recharts graphs, quick entry modals
layouts.transaction_section: Uang Masuk & Uang Keluar table with filters, badge categories (Grosir, Warung, Pakan, Operasional), search, and Rp currency formatting
layouts.nota_section: Digital professional Receipt (Nota) generator with thermal print preview, customer details, itemized egg crates (peti/rak/butir), and print support

motion.entrance: Framer Motion staggered fade-up and floating physics

accessibility.contrast: APCA compliant high contrast dark text (#1C1917) on warm sand backgrounds (#FAF9F5)
accessibility.aria_labels: All interactive buttons and inputs equipped with aria-labels and data-testid attributes

media.hero_3d: Interactive 3D Floating Egg with anti-gravity physics simulator using React Three Fiber

images.description: Golden luxury egg 3D render for brand visual anchor
Fresh farm eggs basket in warm lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a gorgeous, fully functional Indonesian finance & bookkeeping web app named 'catatanBarokah Telur'.
Include a stunning landing page featuring a 3D Anti-Gravity Floating Egg interactive canvas using React Three Fiber / Drei Float.
Include complete Financial Dashboard with total revenue, expenses, net profit, and egg stock tracking in Peti/Rak.
Include Uang Masuk & Uang Keluar transaction management with category filtering and real-time balance updates.
Include Nota (Digital Receipt) generator with itemized calculation and printable thermal layout.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Use Indonesian language throughout the UI ('Pemasukan', 'Pengeluaran', 'Stok Peti', 'Nota Pembelian', etc.).
